name: Mento Brazilian Real
oneLiner: BRLm is Mento's Brazilian real stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing BRLm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the BRLm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BRLm is documented as a Mento stable on Celo and the editable registry has only a Celo deployment. The row was reviewed as native/single-chain for bridge-route scoring.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: BRLm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

mintAuthority.summary: BRLm is minted via the Mento Broker (0x777A...) which is the sole authorized minter (broker() getter confirmed). The Broker's proxy admin and the BRLm token owner and proxy admin all resolve to the Mento Timelock (0x890DB...) with a 2-day delay.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Timelock — BRLm token owner and proxy admin
